## What's free

Monthly: CDN 100 GB per region + 1M requests, Compute 10M requests + 100M vCPU-ms, 5 GB object storage, 1 GB KV store, 5 TLS domains

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.fastly.com/pricing> before relying on this.

## Notes

CDN bandwidth is metered per region. Check what happens on overage before adding a card.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
